_comment: Condensed failure-mode catalog for bl2_triage. docs/FAILURE_MODES.md is the narrative; this file is what the tool prints. kind: instrument (the run failed, the build is fine), build (the build or spec is wrong), config (game folder / install state), info (worth knowing, not a failure).

F8.symptom: the mod's hooks never fire and unrealsdk.log shows no error
F8.fix: write sdk_mods/settings/<mod>.json with {"enabled": true} before launching

F10.symptom: Launcher.exe splash sat between Steam and the game
F10.fix: kill Launcher.exe and start Binaries\Win32\Borderlands2.exe directly (the driver does this)

F12.symptom: game dies ~3 s after launch; unrealsdk.log stops right after pyunrealsdk init
F12.fix: a SHA1-checked base package was modified; restore it from backup and ship NEW .upk files only

F13.symptom: the package loads but none of its exports exist
F13.fix: export entries must have ExportFlags=0; rebuild the package with the current writer

F16.symptom: hard crash during map load with a Fatal error dialog
F16.fix: register fragments/parts at the main menu (options.register_at: menu) before any save loads

F17.symptom: the map load after registration dies with 'Ran out of virtual memory'
F17.fix: root every loaded/constructed object (options.keep_alive: true); disk space is not involved

F18.symptom: a saved weapon reloads with the custom part slot null
F18.fix: options.save_roundtrip must be true so the save/load hooks record and restore the part paths

F19.symptom: the whole custom weapon disappears on load, no crash
F19.fix: options.validate_override must be true (ValidateWeaponDefinition forced for our parts)

F20.symptom: captures are byte-identical run after run or show the desktop
F20.fix: the game lost the foreground and stopped presenting; clear whatever took focus and rerun (prefer borderless fullscreen)

F22.symptom: stable_across_runs fails at 0.7-1.5 % in third person for a build that renders correctly
F22.fix: the third-person crop is mostly animated pawn; run with --capture-view first

F23.symptom: a first-person run captured in third person; a Steam screenshot toast is in the frame
F23.fix: F12 is Steam's screenshot key and the view toggle; re-emit with harness_capture_view so the view is held

F24.symptom: a part that should draw nothing draws a stock fragment, or a body draws extra attachments
F24.fix: re-emit with the current templates (fragment-less parts clear GestaltModeSkeletalMeshName, every clone clears the additional names)

F25.symptom: the harness phase machine finishes in under a second; the capture is of the wrong gun
F25.fix: phase waits were tick-counted; set options.harness_timing: "seconds" and re-emit

F27.symptom: every focus and capture fails while the game is alive; a system dialog owns the foreground
F27.fix: dismiss the dialog (FindWindowEx OK + BM_CLICK) and rerun; the build is unaffected

F28.symptom: an installed build behaves like an older version of itself
F28.fix: re-emit every build, enabled or parked, after any templates.py change and copy them in by hand

F29.symptom: the load hook reports parts missing; a weapon that lost its parts cannot be repaired
F29.fix: make sure the mod that registered those parts is the one enabled; records merge on save and retire on load

F30.symptom: the live save differs from the pre-run backup minutes after a verified restore
F30.fix: the save folder is cloud-synced; take an independent copy before a session and treat the restore flag as 'at that time'

F31.symptom: every menu probe reads yellow=0 and stable_across_runs reports 70-85 %
F31.fix: the capture is not 1920x1080; every pixel box is calibrated there. Set the game to 1920x1080 or rely on compare.scale_box

F32.symptom: the unattended driver loses focus repeatedly with no dialog on screen
F32.fix: the console that launched the loop raised its window; drive with echo=False, redirect stdout, run in the background

F33.symptom: first-person stable_across_runs fails at 0.5-5 % for a weapon that fills the crop; captures visually identical
F33.fix: idle sway on an all-edge crop; the stability check now uses compare.SWAY_TOLERANCE_PX -- rerun with the current bl2_verify

F34.symptom: our weapon is held but draws nothing (empty hands); every pixel condition can still pass
F34.fix: the weapon was built from a gestalt that does not hold our fragments: with own_gestalt the balance's part-list collections must name our WeaponTypeDefinition (AssociatedWeaponType); re-emit

F35.symptom: menu_setup fails in load_extra_packages: load_package returned None for a package we wrote
F35.fix: the package summary claims a newer EngineVersion (TPS 2630070) than BL2 (1712575); write it with a BL2 package as the header template

BACKPACK.symptom: the grant landed in no slot, so the equip picked up whatever was in hand
BACKPACK.fix: the backpack is full; run against a clean save backup (backup/saves/<oldest>) and restore the live save afterwards

ELEMENTAL.symptom: an elemental part rolled on the test weapon, changing the capture between runs
ELEMENTAL.fix: pin ElementalPartData to a fragment-less part in the harness spec (or leave the field out to keep the template's bEnabled)

INVENTORY.symptom: harness_pose inventory left the item card open, so the save-and-quit keys went to the card
INVENTORY.fix: capture-only pose today; close the card before scoring or read the other three conditions

RULE3.symptom: two pipeline mods enabled on the same host gestalt (or an Armory beside one of its weapons)
RULE3.fix: park all but one under sdk_mods/_disabled/ and move its settings JSON with it

REGFAIL.symptom: menu_setup never reached ok=true: a fragment, part, material or balance failed to construct
REGFAIL.fix: read the error text below; it names the object. Lint the spec (--lint-only) and re-emit

F36.symptom: menu probes blind; captures smaller than the physical desktop (a top-left crop)
F36.fix: Windows display scaling with a DPI-unaware capture; capture.ps1 is DPI-aware since 2026-09-24 -- make sure the installed copy is current and rerun

F37.symptom: a --hud-watch run captured no HUD frames
F37.fix: a live setres stalls BL2 until input arrives; launch each size with run_loop --game-res WxH and keep harness_hud_test.resolutions empty

F38.symptom: the run's save backup covered fewer slots than the save folder holds
F38.fix: the loop plays the save CONTINUE loads (the last played); restore that slot from a live snapshot, and use a SaveGuard that backs up every slot (2026-09-27+)
